# 14 §10.3 setup screen walk-through. Run with: --home <fresh temp dir> --conform play THIS --out DIR2
# Paths are relative to this script's folder.
setup
state s0_initial
drop ../../containers/data_not_image.iso
state s1_unknown
drop ../../containers/data_plain.iso ../../containers/dos_deflate.zip
state s2_both_ok
press TAB
press ENTER
wait 3
state s3_installing
press ESC
state s4_cancelled
click 100 202
type ../../containers/data_root.iso
press ENTER
state s5_typed
press ENTER
wait 100
state s6_complete
wait 150
state s7_load_failed
